_comment: One entry per audit under audits/. `repos` maps upstream GitHub repositories to the project; `findings` is the count of confirmed findings from the status table in README.md (hand-maintained; update when an audit changes). `channel` explains audits with no GitHub repository. `fork` is the project's fork of the upstream repository; if that fork carries the topic named in `declines_topic`, the maintainers have said they do not take AI-generated contributions and nothing further is filed, commented or pushed for that repository. `declines_ai: true` can also be set here by hand.

audits.name: FSL
audits.channel: reports and patches ready; filing goes through the FSL mailing list, not GitHub

audits.name: Scrublet
audits.channel: two findings are in Scanpy's port and are filed against scverse/scanpy; the original repository has had no maintainer activity since 2020

audits.name: umap-learn
audits.attributed_note: 202 papers name the program or a package that calls it, 562 name another implementation (uwot (Seurat, Monocle, ArchR, Signac)), 347 name only the method

audits.name: IQ-TREE
audits.channel: no wrong number on master; four notes, a Discussion draft is prepared

audits.name: edgeR
audits.channel: Bioconductor support site (no GitHub tracker; bioc/edgeR is a read-only mirror)

audits.name: GSEA
audits.attributed_note: 69 papers name the program or a package that calls it, 233 name another implementation (fgsea, clusterProfiler, GSVA/ssGSEA, GSEApy, web tools), 418 name only the method

audits.name: AlphaFold 3
audits.attributed_note: code review of the inference and data-pipeline code (2026-09-02), not survey-driven

audits.name: Picard
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 289 papers; 3 confirmed on master and four releases (RNA-seq transcript coverage, HsMetrics zero-coverage fraction, bisulfite mismatch rate), 4 notes; MarkDuplicates, insert size, WGS and alignment summary held up

audits.name: Bowtie 2
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 477 papers; 4 confirmed on master and five release binaries (mate-2 MAPQ length slip on master, XS:i missing on unpaired mates, --no-mixed suppresses discordant alignments, spurious insertions just above -X), 3 notes; scoring, MAPQ port, pair classification and the alignment summary held up

audits.name: FastQC
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 322 papers; 3 confirmed on master and three release archives (encoding misdetection when no quality is below 31, per-read mean quality truncated, GC module truncates reads to 100 bases), 4 notes; the other modules held up

audits.name: VCFtools
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 112 papers; 3 confirmed on master, v0.1.16, v0.1.13 and the Ubuntu package (every temporary-file output mode aborts on a fortified source build, --relatedness2 underestimates kinship with missing genotypes, --max-missing-count counts alleles not genotypes), 3 notes; the diversity, Fst, LD, HWE and filter code held up

audits.name: scDblFinder
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 179 papers; 3 confirmed on the 1.16.0 release and 1.4.0/1.8.0/1.12.0 builds, devel read (artificial-doublet origins mislabelled with the default size adjustment so mostLikelyOrigin is mostly wrong, factor cluster labels empty the per-combination stats, the dbr threshold is NaN without artificial doublets), 2 notes; the doublet calls, expected-doublet arithmetic, cxds2 and thresholding rules held up

audits.name: NumPy
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 253 papers; 0 confirmed on 2.4.6 and 1.23.5/1.24.4/1.26.4 (no wrong number for a documented definition), 5 notes (float32 slow-axis reductions, open upstream as #22956/#8869; closest_observation ties fixed in 2.1.0; non-PSD multivariate_normal; float32 FFT precision; round-half-even at 2.675); quantiles, histograms, polyfit, linalg, FFT and the generators held up; nothing to file

audits.name: scikit-learn
audits.attributed_note: survey cohort of 322 papers; 2 confirmed on 1.9.1 and 1.5.2, main read (PCA's covariance_eigh solver, the auto choice for tall dense data since 1.5, loses the variance of offset features: 33 % off for float32 values around 100; NMF.reconstruction_err_ is sqrt(2 D_beta), not the divergence), 1 note open upstream (#31210 euclidean_distances precision) + 4 notes; every metric, PCA(full/arpack/randomized), the scalers, KMeans, GaussianMixture, the splitters and the linear models held up

author: cindykrafft
